source: Homes.com October 2026 housing report; Freddie Mac PMMS

headline: Sales sink, prices
*hold their ground*
slides.fig_caption: US home sales in October vs. a year earlier
slides.sub: Buyers have more homes to choose from, and they are getting choosier.

slides.label: national median sale price in October, *down just 0.4%*
slides.body: Inventory rose 4.8% from a year earlier. Homes.com's chief economist reads it as demand holding up while buyers become more selective.

slides.title: Where sales fell *hardest*
slides.note: Condo and townhome prices each fell 1.4% from a year ago, while single-family prices slipped *only 0.3%*.

slides.title: Local markets *split*
points: San Francisco prices jumped *17.7%* even as sales fell 13%.
Austin prices fell *9.7%* and Nashville's fell 4.1%.
Seattle has 22.8% more homes for sale, while Jacksonville has 9.8% fewer.

slides.title: Price it local, *not national*
slides.body: A flat national median hides big swings by market and property type. With the 30-year rate back up to 7.28% and buyers comparing more homes, sharp local comps and move-in-ready condition matter more than ever.
